modes.name: guarded_implication
modes.instruction: Propose candidate guarded implications. Use state15 or state17 as consequent with 1-2 antecedent variables as guards. Avoid direct 'state15=0'.

modes.name: satellite_generalization
modes.instruction: Look at frame clauses sharing state15 with varying satellite variables. Propose lemmas that generalize across satellites.

modes.name: clause_family_compression
modes.instruction: Find repeated OR-clause patterns in frame clauses. Propose lemmas that could replace multiple clauses.

modes.name: transition_causal_guard
modes.instruction: Propose lemmas with guards derived from the transition logic. Use variable dependency information.

modes.name: protocol_invariant
modes.instruction: Propose bus-handshake or protocol-style invariants involving state790 (stall), state2002 (request), or state1536 (mode).

modes.name: near_miss_repair
modes.instruction: Given previous near-miss failures (init-fail or one-step-fail), propose weakened or guarded variants.

modes.name: nary_mutex
modes.instruction: Propose mutual exclusion lemmas involving 2-3 variables. Look for pairs that IC3IA frame clauses suggest cannot co-occur.

modes.name: diverse_explore
modes.instruction: Explore diverse lemma families. Try schemas not used by other modes. Be creative but conservative.
